fields.objection: The endpoint converges faster than the maximum integration-point face stress near the pole. A coarse-grid first-yield estimate can move the inferred tolerance.
fields.proposed_fix: Use the filed mesh/step boundary checks and their brackets; avoid precision beyond those checks. Retain both-face integration-point histories.
